findings.finding: ATTRIBUTION.md contains a stale version string '0.1.1' in the metadata on line 6, while the actual pack version has been advanced to '0.2.0' in lesson.json and other json files.
findings.resolution: Update the version string in ATTRIBUTION.md to '0.2.0' on line 6.

findings.finding: The clinical wrap-up scene successfully synthesizes the lesson's main outcomes (classification of target inference, drawing causal arrow maps, choosing adjustment variables, and calibrating causal attribution) using an illustrative medical scenario while maintaining a strict disclaimer that it is for learning practice and not clinical advice.
findings.resolution: No changes required; preserve this scene.

findings.finding: The active prerequisite diagnostic check at the start of Scene 1 successfully activates prerequisite study design knowledge from PREM-SCI-004 in a non-punitive manner and provides a clear recovery route, preventing cognitive overload.
findings.resolution: No changes required; preserve this check.

findings.finding: The worked example 'worked-example-app-evidence' in Scene 3 is highly structured and conforms to the CONTENT-STANDARD.md worked-example guidelines, providing clear causal mapping, plans, and self-explanation prompts.
findings.resolution: No changes required; preserve this worked example.

findings.finding: The misconception block 'misconception-adjust-everything' effectively targets a common learner error (adjusting for all variables associated with exposure and outcome) and uses a structured sequence (commit, why 'yes' fails, better model, recheck) that aligns well with the content standard's didactical requirements.
findings.resolution: No changes required; preserve this misconception repair.

findings.finding: The transfer task 'check-transfer-laboratory' successfully requires the learner to adapt and apply causal attribution and natural-experiment checks to a novel laboratory domain without copying the wording of the worked example.
findings.resolution: No changes required; preserve this transfer check.

limitations: The reviewer was unable to read site/schemas/review.schema.json, site/data/premed-terminology.json, or the cross-lesson terminology ledger because they are located in site/, which was strictly prohibited from being read by the user's SCOPE instructions for this run.

The reviewer is an AI agent without human credentials or empirical learner testing capabilities. Its judgment is limited to theoretical learning design principles, internal consistency, and alignment check against standard schemas and guidelines.
The review did not involve real learner cohort testing or interactive user experience evaluation.
All data and settings analyzed are fictional teaching materials and are treated as such.
